ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with arrows pointing to predators. In the diagram, Hognose Snake has an arrow pointing to Hawk; Garter Snake has an upward arrow pointing to Hawk; the line on the right side of Sparrow goes around to the top and points with an arrow to Hawk. Reasoning: The question asks what garter snake, sparrow, and hognose snake are eaten by. The arrows of all three organisms commonly point to Hawk, so the common predator is hawk.
